units.source_text: 这二公主生得相貌十分美丽，今上也非常怜爱她。

en.t: This Second Princess was born very beautiful, and the reigning emperor also loved her dearly.

units.source_text: 只因明石皇后所生大公主一向宠爱无比，故世人一般都以为二公主不及大公主，但实际情况并不稍逊。

en.t: Because the First Princess born to Empress Akashi had always been cherished beyond compare, people generally assumed that the Second Princess was inferior to her, but in truth she was not in the least behind her.

units.source_text: 女御的父亲左大臣在世时威望显赫，至今余势尚未全衰。

en.t: When the lady's father, the Minister of the Left, was alive, his prestige was illustrious, and even now the remaining force of his influence had not entirely faded.

units.source_text: 故女御生涯十分优裕，自众侍女服饰以至四时行乐等事，无不体面周到，度着新颖而高雅的生活。

en.t: Thus the lady's life was extremely comfortable; from the clothing of her many attendants to the amusements of the four seasons, everything was proper and carefully arranged, and she lived in a fresh and elegant style.

units.source_text: 二公主十四岁时，将举行着裳仪式。

en.t: When the Second Princess was fourteen, her mogi coming-of-age ceremony was to be held.

units.source_text: 从春天起，就停止其他一切事务，专心准备这仪式。

en.t: From spring onward, all other affairs were set aside, and attention was devoted solely to preparing for this ceremony.

units.source_text: 无论何事，务求尽善尽美，与众不同。

en.t: In every matter, they strove for perfection and for something unlike anything ordinary people would do.

units.source_text: 祖先传下来的宝物，此时正好应用，故多方搜集，悉心装备。

en.t: The treasures handed down from their ancestors were just suited for use at this time, so they gathered them from every quarter and prepared them with the utmost care.

units.source_text: 正在此时，藤壶女御于夏间被妖魔所祟，竟致一病不起，呜呼哀哉！

en.t: Just then, in the summer, the Fujitsubo Consort was afflicted by an evil spirit and at last fell ill so severely that she could not rise again. Alas, how sorrowful!

units.source_text: 此乃无可奈何之事，今上也只有悲伤叹息。

en.t: There was nothing that could be done, and the reigning emperor could only grieve and sigh.

units.source_text: 这位女御为人情深意密，和蔼可亲，故殿上人无不悼惜，他们说道：“宫中少了这位女御，今后将何等寂寞啊！”

en.t: This consort was deeply affectionate, thoughtful, gentle, and approachable, so all the courtiers mourned her and said, "With this lady gone from the palace, how lonely it will be from now on!"

units.source_text: 连地位并不甚高的女官，也没有一人不思慕她。

en.t: Even among the court ladies of no very high rank, there was not one who did not long for her.

units.source_text: 何况二公主年纪还小，更是悲伤痛哭，恋念不已。

en.t: All the more so, since the Second Princess was still young, she wept in grief and could not cease longing for her mother.

units.source_text: 今上闻之，心中难过，又很可怜她，便在七七四十九日丧忌过后，悄悄地把她迎回宫中，并且天天到她室中看顾。

en.t: When the emperor heard of this, his heart ached and he pitied her deeply; after the forty-nine days of mourning had passed, he quietly brought her back to the palace and went every day to her rooms to look after her.

units.source_text: 二公主身穿黑色孝服，容颜瘦削，姿色反比从前更加娟秀可爱。

en.t: The Second Princess wore black mourning clothes, and though her face had grown thin, her beauty seemed even more graceful and lovely than before.

units.source_text: 性情也非常柔顺，比母亲藤壶女御沉静稳重，今上看了不胜欣慰。

en.t: Her nature was also very gentle and obedient, calmer and more composed than that of her mother, the Fujitsubo Consort, and the emperor was greatly comforted when he saw her.

units.source_text: 然而有一个实际问题：她母亲的娘家没有权势旺盛的母舅可做她的后援人，只有大藏卿和修理大夫，又都是她母亲的异母兄弟。

en.t: Yet there was a practical difficulty: in her mother's family there was no powerful maternal uncle who could serve as her patron, only the Chief of the Treasury and the Master of Repairs, both half-brothers of her mother.

units.source_text: 这两人在世间既无人望，又无高贵地位。

en.t: These two men had neither public esteem nor exalted rank in the world.

units.source_text: 做女子的以此等人为保护人，实在是很痛苦的。

en.t: For a woman to have such people as her protectors was truly a painful situation.

units.source_text: 今上觉得她很可怜，便亲自照顾她，为她操心之处甚多。

en.t: The emperor felt great pity for her, so he cared for her himself and worried over many matters on her behalf.
